case_number: 2024 INSC 6; CRIMINAL APPEAL NOS. 1420 OF 2019, 36 OF 2024
summary: Abduction, attempted murder, and robbery case; conviction under s.364-A IPC questioned due to lack of ransom demand proof in victim's statement; burn injuries and neck ligature mark corroborate prosecution case; victim's statement before Executive Magistrate treated as reliable; father's ransom demand claim unsubstantiated; s.364-A conviction unsafe while s.307/120B and s.392/397 upheld; limited notice issued earlier for s.364-A challenge.
final_judgment: Conviction under s.364-A set aside; sentences under s.307/120B and s.392/397 upheld; life imprisonment partially modified.
